newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AWB sells AH1 at A$230/t in sixth tender.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AWB sells AH1 at A$230/t in sixth tender.

text.p: The Australian Wheat Board (AWB) said it sold 2,000 tonnes of Australian Hard1 (AH1) new crop wheat at A$230 a tonne from its pools in its sixth domestic tender held on Wednesday.
Bids were submitted for 6,000 tonnes of new crop wheat in the single port zone of Fremantle, AWB said.
The highest failed bid was for AH13 wheat at A$241, AWB said. Closing date for the next tender is September 25.
